result.response:
The bug has been fixed and verified.

### Root Cause
In [`ZipArchiveEntry.java`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/compress_13_group_d_fix/src/main/java/org/apache/commons/compress/archivers/zip/ZipArchiveEntry.java#L509-L515), entry names originating from FAT/Windows platforms containing backslashes were not being normalized to standard forward slash (`/`) path separators when no forward slash existed in the name.

### Solution
Updated [`ZipArchiveEntry.setName(String)`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/compress_13_group_d_fix/src/main/java/org/apache/commons/compress/archivers/zip/ZipArchiveEntry.java#L509-L515) to normalize backslashes (`\`) to forward slashes (`/`) when the platform is `PLATFORM_FAT` and the entry name does not already contain a forward slash:

```java
    protected void setName(String name) {
        if (name != null && getPlatform() == PLATFORM_FAT
            && name.indexOf("/") == -1) {
            name = name.replace('\\', '/');
        }
        this.name = name;
    }
```

### Verification
Ran the verification test suite:
```bash
export TZ='America/Los_Angeles'; export _JAVA_OPTIONS='-Duser.language=en -Duser.country=US -Duser.timezone=America/Los_Angeles'; mvn test -Dtest=CucumberTest
```
All Cucumber scenarios passed successfully.

The patch file containing only the source code modification has been generated and saved at [`enlightened_fix.patch`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/compress_13_group_d_fix/enlightened_fix.patch).
